content_blocks.title: Work through the example
content_blocks.text: Read the small example, predict every output line, then run it locally with a compatible runtime. Garbage collection is nondeterministic; explicit collection is useful for controlled experiments, not a general per-request optimization. Keep the smallest reproducible case if the observed behavior differs.

content_blocks.code:
local values = {}
for i = 1, 1000 do values[i] = i end
print(#values)
values = nil
collectgarbage("collect")
